lesson: On 2026-06-01 payments-api OOM in checkout: node pool checkout-np-2 ran out of memory during traffic spike. Fix: raise container memory limit and add nodes to checkout pool.
full:
## payments-api OOM (checkout)

**When:** 2026-06-01 traffic spike.

**Symptom:** Pod evicted / ServiceUnavailable on payments-api in checkout namespace.

**Root cause:** Node pool checkout-np-2 memory pressure; heap growth exceeded limit.

**Fix:** Raise JVM/container memory limit; scale checkout node pool; verify p95 latency after reschedule.

lesson: On 2026-06-02 api-gateway 5xx after v2.14.0 deploy: UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT=500ms too aggressive for auth cold starts. Fix: rollback to v2.13.2 and raise timeout.
full:
## api-gateway deploy regression (edge)

**When:** 2026-06-02, 8 minutes after v2.14.0 rollout.

**Symptom:** HighErrorRate on api-gateway in edge namespace.

**Root cause:** New default UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT=500ms caused upstream connect timeouts to auth-service.

**Fix:** Roll back to v2.13.2; set timeout to 2s; extend canary analysis window.
